encode_xyz_coordinates_to_key: encode x, y, z coordinates into a shuffled z-order key using pre-computed lookup tables
decode_shuffled_key_to_coordinates: decode a shuffled z-order key back into x, y, z coordinates and batch index
build_key_lut_for_device: build a KeyLUT instance with encode and decode lookup tables for a given device
encode_batched_coordinates: encode batched x, y, z coordinates with batch index into a single shuffled key
test_key_roundtrip: test xyz2key and key2xyz functions for coordinate roundtrip correctness
